### Is Kodi dying?

The Kodi software is not shutting down and still receives updates. The ecosystem around it is the part in decline. Search interest has fallen steadily, as the trend above shows, and many of the third-party add-ons that made Kodi appealing to cord-cutters have been abandoned by their developers. For most cord-cutters that distinction does not matter much, because an add-on that no longer works is the reason they came in the first place. [...] Abandoned add-ons and builds, broken repositories, and a steeper learning curve have pushed users toward simpler options like other media centers and APKs.
